about: Avatar standing spots on the full painting. Each spot is [x percent, feet y percent, size]. Spots are ordered for visitors; avatars reserve their own spot when present. Backdrop entries follow the exact painting path.

station.note: Travellers stand on the wooden waiting-room floor. The keeper stands beside the timetable. The platform door stays visible between the front figures.

attic.note: Feet rest on the broad floorboards around the mirror. The lower left lane leaves space beside the stair rail.

pond.note: The cast stands on the near muddy shore. Pip takes the bank by the reeds. The open water and distant mirror stay above the foot line.

theatre.note: Mara has the centre of the little stage. Visitors use the floor in front and the open side aisles.

belfry.note: The broad stone floor gives Ash a spot beside the bell. Guests stand inside the rope rail.

glasshouse.note: Iris stands beside the left planting bench. The cast follows the clear floor between the beds and the open garden doorway.

hill.note: Tavi stands on the earth by the fence. The wider near path carries the other figures and keeps the valley in view.

train.note: Rue stands in the central aisle near the end door. The other spots stay on the wooden aisle between the benches.

pavilion.note: Cass stands beside the game table. Visitors use the clear paving between the front columns.

loft.note: Sage and her chair use the broad level boards on the right. The other spots keep to the floor beneath the hanging sail.

boardyai-parlour.note: Boardy stands by the open doorway. Visitors use the foreground boards around the rug, with the tea table visible behind them.
